svg.title: 06b · RBAC and Organisational Roles: Target
svg.desc: Proposed operating model. Eleven roles (seven human, four machine) with their scope; a role-permission matrix covering FSPIOP APIs, onboarding, limits and funds, settlement, portal, Kubernetes, deployment, secrets, databases, Kafka, monitoring and audit; and the enforcement layer for each kind of access.
svg.text: Proposed operational roles (not existing Mojaloop roles), what each may do, and where each permission is enforced
F full · W write / operate · R read · O own participant only · – none
non-prod: only in non-production environments · break-glass: time-limited, logged emergency access
Gateway mTLS + OAuth2 client bound to FSPIOP-Source; switch validates JWS
Enforced at: Operator APIs and portal
OIDC SSO + MFA → identity-aware proxy (x-user) → permission checks (Ory Keto is already supported by the reporting API)
RBAC Roles bound to SSO groups · one ServiceAccount per workload · admission policies
Per-service DB users · Kafka ACLs per topic and group · vault policies per role and service account
These are proposed operational roles: the repository implements none of them (see 06a). Align role names with your organisation and the scheme rules.
